_what: LAB ONLY (Air's scaffold task, 2026-10-05). A new floor shape for the ten frozen Corpus B draws: four terse semantic fields per draw — CONDITION, DOMAIN, OPERATION, INVARIANT — derived by hand by True from the canonical record (status line + the card's or parent's state line), the seat, the medicine partner's operation line and acts, the mechanism, and the back-in-balance face. No second person, no metaphor, no taught figure, no invented specifics. Provenance on every field. Never on the production floor.
